text: This ship-cleaning demo ships a language its store page doesn't sell.
Vietnamese. It's in the build. It's not on the page.
It's Seaside Wash. You scrape barnacles and rust off wrecked ships.
Six hundred and nine megabytes. A hundred and ninety-one files.
It's Unity on Mono, so the localization tables sit there with their names on them.
English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified and Traditional Chinese. And Vietnamese, which the page never mentions.
Somebody already translated the whole thing. So either it's coming, or it got cut.
Worth a dip. Every demo I open, I read the file list first.
